definitions.explanation: Water found beneath the Earth's surface in soil pores and rock fractures.

examples.japanese: {地下水|ちかすい}を{汲|く}み{上|あ}げる。
この{地域|ちいき}の{地下水|ちかすい}は{飲料|いんりょう}{水|すい}として{使|つか}われている。
examples.english: The groundwater in this area is used as drinking water.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}からの{廃棄物|はいきぶつ}で{地下水|ちかすい}が{汚染|おせん}された。
examples.english: The groundwater was contaminated by waste from the factory.

notes:
{地下水|ちかすい} refers to water found beneath the earth's surface in soil and rock formations. A compound of {地下|ちか} (underground) + {水|すい} (water).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地下水|ちかすい}を{汲|く}み{上|あ}げる: to pump up groundwater
- {地下水|ちかすい}の{汚染|おせん}: groundwater contamination
- {地下水|ちかすい}の{枯渇|こかつ}: depletion of groundwater
- {地下水|ちかすい}{脈|みゃく}: underground water vein, aquifer
- {地下水|ちかすい}{位|い}: groundwater level

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many Japanese regions rely on groundwater for drinking water and agriculture. Kumamoto Prefecture is particularly famous for its abundant {地下水|ちかすい}. Excessive pumping ({過剰|かじょう}{汲|く}み{上|あ}げ) has caused {地盤沈下|じばんちんか} (land subsidence) in some urban areas.

RELATED WORDS:
- {井戸水|いどみず}: well water
- {水源|すいげん}: water source
- {湧|わ}き{水|みず}: spring water
